findings.detail: Graph key, descriptor geometry, dispatch and control normalization assume query length one; target query width must be a strict negotiated immutable shape, with default one omitted from old wire.
FFN role isolation deletes speculative_config before load_model derives decode_query_len. Retain only immutable target shape metadata before isolation; keep native drafter and Engram absent on FFN.

Native target capture precedes draft capture within the broad outer scope, but target manager identity, cleared session, selected target ModelState and attention-metadata identity separate current hooks. Add behavior tests rather than asserting draft contamination from scope width alone.

Pinned AscendDSparkSpeculator independently honors speculative_config.enforce_eager, so first wave can retain native target FULL capture while draft manager remains NONE without another compatibility patch.
